Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

  • Breathable mesh has real and synthetic leather overlays to give a 2000s running aesthetic.
  • Foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning for a plush underfoot feel.
  • No-slip full rubber outsole gives you durable traction.
  • Tongue webbing features \"Bowerman Series\" branding.
  • Nike logo on tongue tab.
  • Molded synthetic leather Swoosh design.

Pieces of the past add up to an amazing look for right now with the Nike P-6000, which draws from the Nike Air Pegasus 25 and the Pegasus 2006 for a mash-up of iconic styles that's breathable, comfortable, and evocative of that early-2000s vibe.

  • Breathable mesh has real and synthetic leather overlays to give a 2000s running aesthetic.
  • Foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning for a plush underfoot feel.
  • No-slip full rubber outsole gives you durable traction.
  • Tongue webbing features \"Bowerman Series\" branding.
  • Nike logo on tongue tab.
  • Molded synthetic leather Swoosh design.

Pieces of the past add up to an amazing look for right now with the Nike P-6000, which draws from the Nike Air Pegasus 25 and the Pegasus 2006 for a mash-up of iconic styles that's breathable, comfortable, and evocative of that early-2000s vibe.

  • Breathable mesh has real and synthetic leather overlays to give a 2000s running aesthetic.
  • Foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning for a plush underfoot feel.
  • No-slip full rubber outsole gives you durable traction.
  • Tongue webbing features \"Bowerman Series\" branding.
  • Nike logo on tongue tab.
  • Molded synthetic leather Swoosh design.

The One
Simply put, the Men's Nike Air Max 1 is one of the most iconic sneakers of all time, and certainly also one of the most historic in Nike’s catalog. First released in 1987 as a performance running shoe, the Air Max 1 was designed by legendary Nike designer Tinker Hatfield and was the first sneaker ever to feature a visible window to expose the Air cushioning within the midsole. The shoe with “maximum Air” was an instant classic, loved in 1987 for its bold look and amazing comfort. As Nike’s running technology progressed, the Air Max 1 became obsolete as a performance running shoe, but its status as a casual favorite seems to increase with each passing year. Released in a countless number of colorways, materials, remodels, and reconstructions throughout the years, the Air Max 1 ranks with the most popular sneakers for men, women, and kids across the globe. Truly, no sneaker collection is complete without a pair.

The Style Is Clear
If you’re looking for a sneaker with all-day comfort and classic style, you need to look no further than the Air Max 1. Always in production and always being released in new colorways in addition to the much-anticipated return of original colorways from time to time, Foot Locker is confident that everyone can find a version of the iconic sneaker to match their own personal style. From the original mesh construction, to leather and suede makeovers, to eye-catching graphic-covered editions, the Air Max 1 can definitely do it all thanks to its clean lines and timeless silhouette that can be worn with virtually anything. Whether it’s your first or fiftieth pair, the latest Air Max 1 releases are ready and waiting here at Foot Locker in a wide range of men’s sizing. Pick up a fresh pair and start walking on Air today.

• Mesh, textile, leather, and/or synthetic upper. See each style for specific construction.
• Low-top silhouette with high-profile midsole for classic Air Max 1 design.
• Foam midsole for lightweight cushion.
• Large visible Air unit in heel for signature look.
• Waffle rubber outsole for durability and ample traction.

The One
Simply put, the Men's Nike Air Max 1 is one of the most iconic sneakers of all time, and certainly also one of the most historic in Nike’s catalog. First released in 1987 as a performance running shoe, the Air Max 1 was designed by legendary Nike designer Tinker Hatfield and was the first sneaker ever to feature a visible window to expose the Air cushioning within the midsole. The shoe with “maximum Air” was an instant classic, loved in 1987 for its bold look and amazing comfort. As Nike’s running technology progressed, the Air Max 1 became obsolete as a performance running shoe, but its status as a casual favorite seems to increase with each passing year. Released in a countless number of colorways, materials, remodels, and reconstructions throughout the years, the Air Max 1 ranks with the most popular sneakers for men, women, and kids across the globe. Truly, no sneaker collection is complete without a pair.

The Style Is Clear
If you’re looking for a sneaker with all-day comfort and classic style, you need to look no further than the Air Max 1. Always in production and always being released in new colorways in addition to the much-anticipated return of original colorways from time to time, Foot Locker is confident that everyone can find a version of the iconic sneaker to match their own personal style. From the original mesh construction, to leather and suede makeovers, to eye-catching graphic-covered editions, the Air Max 1 can definitely do it all thanks to its clean lines and timeless silhouette that can be worn with virtually anything. Whether it’s your first or fiftieth pair, the latest Air Max 1 releases are ready and waiting here at Foot Locker in a wide range of men’s sizing. Pick up a fresh pair and start walking on Air today.

• Mesh, textile, leather, and/or synthetic upper. See each style for specific construction.
• Low-top silhouette with high-profile midsole for classic Air Max 1 design.
• Foam midsole for lightweight cushion.
• Large visible Air unit in heel for signature look.
• Waffle rubber outsole for durability and ample traction.

The One
Simply put, the Men's Nike Air Max 1 is one of the most iconic sneakers of all time, and certainly also one of the most historic in Nike’s catalog. First released in 1987 as a performance running shoe, the Air Max 1 was designed by legendary Nike designer Tinker Hatfield and was the first sneaker ever to feature a visible window to expose the Air cushioning within the midsole. The shoe with “maximum Air” was an instant classic, loved in 1987 for its bold look and amazing comfort. As Nike’s running technology progressed, the Air Max 1 became obsolete as a performance running shoe, but its status as a casual favorite seems to increase with each passing year. Released in a countless number of colorways, materials, remodels, and reconstructions throughout the years, the Air Max 1 ranks with the most popular sneakers for men, women, and kids across the globe. Truly, no sneaker collection is complete without a pair.

The Style Is Clear
If you’re looking for a sneaker with all-day comfort and classic style, you need to look no further than the Air Max 1. Always in production and always being released in new colorways in addition to the much-anticipated return of original colorways from time to time, Foot Locker is confident that everyone can find a version of the iconic sneaker to match their own personal style. From the original mesh construction, to leather and suede makeovers, to eye-catching graphic-covered editions, the Air Max 1 can definitely do it all thanks to its clean lines and timeless silhouette that can be worn with virtually anything. Whether it’s your first or fiftieth pair, the latest Air Max 1 releases are ready and waiting here at Foot Locker in a wide range of men’s sizing. Pick up a fresh pair and start walking on Air today.

• Mesh, textile, leather, and/or synthetic upper. See each style for specific construction.
• Low-top silhouette with high-profile midsole for classic Air Max 1 design.
• Foam midsole for lightweight cushion.
• Large visible Air unit in heel for signature look.
• Waffle rubber outsole for durability and ample traction.

Boasting a colorblocked design, these shorts offer an uber-cool style that intersects perfectly between luxe and laid-back. Made with at least 20% recycled cotton, these shorts ensure you have a minimal environmental impact and promote social responsibility. Take the trends to your sports session with the PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts.

PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts features:

  • Scoot Henderson branding offers a bold look.
  • Drawcords at the waistband ensure a customized fit.
  • Pockets at the hip enable convenient storage.
  • Piece dyed with chemical finishing.
  • 100% polyester recycled, mesh; 145 GSM. Imported.

Boasting a colorblocked design, these shorts offer an uber-cool style that intersects perfectly between luxe and laid-back. Take the trends to your sports session with the PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts.

PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts features:

  • Scoot Henderson branding offers a bold look.
  • Drawcords at the waistband ensure a customized fit.
  • Pockets at the hip enable convenient storage.
  • Piece dyed with chemical finishing.
  • 100% polyester recycled, mesh; 145 GSM. Imported.

Give your everyday fits the ‘Scoot’ treatment with the PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts. Boasting a colorblocked design, these shorts offer an uber-cool style that intersects perfectly between luxe and laid-back. Take the trends to your sports session with the PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts.

PUMA Scoot x NL Shorts features:

  • Scoot Henderson branding offers a bold look.
  • Drawcords at the waistband ensure a customized fit.
  • Pockets at the hip enable convenient storage.
  • Piece dyed with chemical finishing.
  • 100% polyester recycled, mesh; 145 GSM. Imported.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Lace up for greatness! A pinnacle of performance technology, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you aim high and shoot higher for glory. Built for certified bucket getters, these basketball sneakers help you elevate your gameplay to MVP level, just like the king—Anthony Edwards. The Boost midsole with Lightstrike cushioning provides maximum energy return while you power through explosive moves, tricky manoeuvres, and buzzer-beater shots.

Rounded off with a lace closure, these silhouettes offer locked-in support for every take-off and landing. The rubber outsole gives you all the support you need to move dynamically and attack the rim swiftly. Plus, the signature Anthony Edwards branding completes the look and lets you stay ahead of the curve. Locked and loaded for hoops victory, the adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low helps you command the game and outdo your own expectations.

adidas Anthony Edwards 1 Low features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed and easy feel.
  • Textile upper provides maximum comfort and durability.
  • Textile lining prevents dampness and stickiness.

Fusing the magic of cinema with the grit of a basketball court, the Jordan Spizike Low is not just a shoe but a culture moment on the move. Designed for your boys, these sneakers take elements of four classic Jordans and add the magic of MJ's style to their everyday look. An homage to Spike Lee, who formally introduced Hollywood and hoops together, the Jordan Spizike Low is a true masterpiece that completes your boys' larger-than-life collection.

Jordan Spizike Low features:

  • Real and synthetic leather and textile upper add durability.
  • Nike Air technology absorbs impact and offers cushioning with every step.
  • Solid rubber outsole provides enhanced traction.

Fusing the magic of cinema with the grit of a basketball court, the Jordan Spizike Low is not just a shoe but a culture moment on the move. Designed for your boys, these sneakers take elements of four classic Jordans and add the magic of MJ's style to their everyday look. An homage to Spike Lee, who formally introduced Hollywood and hoops together, the Jordan Spizike Low is a true masterpiece that completes your boys' larger-than-life collection.

Jordan Spizike Low features:

  • Real and synthetic leather and textile upper add durability.
  • Nike Air technology absorbs impact and offers cushioning with every step.
  • Solid rubber outsole provides enhanced traction.
